club_summary:
select club, country, top_flight_seasons, first_season, last_season, peak_elo, peak_season,
       seasons_at_1, seasons_top10, best_rank, best_decade, peak_season_label, best_decade_label
from gold.mv_club_summary where measure = 'end' order by peak_elo desc nulls last
club_months:
select club, to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as month, elo
from gold.mv_club_months where club in {{clubs}} order by club, month
club_seasons:
select club, country, season, tier, elo_end, above_field, world_rank, league_rank
from gold.mv_club_seasons where measure = 'end' and club in {{clubs}} order by club, season
table_on_date:
select a.rank::int as rank, a.club, a.country, a.tier, round(a.elo)::int as elo,
       round(a.elo - b.elo)::int as change_12m,
       to_char(coalesce(cast({{as_of}} as date), current_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as as_of
from gold.ratings_on(coalesce(cast({{as_of}} as date), current_date), true) a
left join gold.ratings_on(coalesce(cast({{as_of}} as date), current_date) - 365, false) b using (club)
order by a.rank
league_strength: select season, country, avg_top_flight, best from gold.mv_league_strength where measure = 'end' order by season, country
number_ones: select season, club, country, elo_end, margin, runner_up from gold.mv_number_ones where measure = 'end' order by season
decade_kings:
select decade, pos, club, country, seasons, avg_above_field, best_rank, seasons_at_1
from gold.mv_decade_kings where measure = 'end' order by decade, pos
greatest_seasons:
select club, country, season, season_label, elo_end, elo_peak, above_field, world_rank
from gold.mv_greatest_seasons where measure = 'end' order by above_field desc
upsets:
select match_id, match_date, competition, comp_type, home_club, away_club, home_goals, away_goals, score,
       winner, loser, home_elo, away_elo, winner_chance
from gold.mv_upsets order by winner_chance
trophies: select competition, season, season_label, winner, runner_up, legs from gold.mv_trophies order by season, competition
alltime:
with w as (
  select coalesce(cast({{w_peak}} as float), 25) as a, coalesce(cast({{w_sustain}} as float), 35) as b,
         coalesce(cast({{w_top}} as float), 20) as c, coalesce(cast({{w_long}} as float), 20) as d
)
select club, country, peak_above, best5_above, seasons_at_1, seasons_top10, top_flight_seasons,
       round((100 * (w.a * s_peak + w.b * s_sus + w.c * s_at1 + w.d * s_top10)
              / nullif(w.a + w.b + w.c + w.d, 0))::numeric, 1)::float as score
from gold.mv_alltime_parts cross join w
where measure = 'end'
order by score desc nulls last
limit 60
dynasties:
select club, country, from_season, to_season, span, seasons, avg_rank, seasons_at_1
from gold.mv_dynasties where measure = 'end' and top_n = coalesce(cast({{dyn_top}} as int), 5) order by pos
profile_seasons:
select club, country, season, season_label, tier, elo_end, elo_peak, above_field, world_rank, league_rank
from gold.mv_club_seasons where measure = 'end' and club = coalesce(cast({{profile_club}} as text), 'Liverpool') order by season
profile_matches:
with p as (select coalesce(cast({{profile_club}} as text), 'Liverpool') as club),
ids as (
  select m.match_id from silver.matches m, p where m.home_club = p.club
  union all
  select m.match_id from silver.matches m, p where m.away_club = p.club
),
x as (
  select m.match_id, m.match_date::text as match_date, m.competition,
         case when m.home_club = p.club then m.away_club else m.home_club end as opponent,
         case when m.home_club = p.club then 'home' when m.neutral then 'neutral' else 'away' end as venue,
         m.home_goals || '–' || m.away_goals as score,
         round((case when m.home_club = p.club then r.elo_delta else -r.elo_delta end)::numeric, 1)::float as rating_change,
         round((case when m.home_club = p.club then r.home_win_exp else 1 - r.home_win_exp end)::numeric, 3)::float as expected
  from ids join silver.matches m using (match_id) join gold.match_ratings r using (match_id) cross join p
)
(select 'best' as kind, * from x order by rating_change desc limit 10)
union all
(select 'worst' as kind, * from x order by rating_change asc limit 10)
h2h:
with c as (select coalesce(cast({{h2h_a}} as text), 'Liverpool') as a,
                  coalesce(cast({{h2h_b}} as text), 'Manchester United') as b),
ids as (
  select m.match_id from silver.matches m, c where m.home_club = c.a and m.away_club = c.b
  union all
  select m.match_id from silver.matches m, c where m.home_club = c.b and m.away_club = c.a
)
select m.match_id, m.match_date::text as match_date, m.season, m.competition, m.home_club, m.away_club,
       m.home_goals || '–' || m.away_goals as score,
       case when m.home_goals > m.away_goals then m.home_club when m.home_goals < m.away_goals then m.away_club else 'Draw' end as winner,
       round(r.home_elo_pre)::int as home_elo, round(r.away_elo_pre)::int as away_elo,
       round(r.home_win_exp::numeric, 3)::float as home_expected
from ids join silver.matches m using (match_id) join gold.match_ratings r using (match_id)
order by m.match_date desc
whatif:
with d as (
  select coalesce(cast({{wi_a_date}} as date), date '1999-05-27') as da,
         coalesce(cast({{wi_b_date}} as date), date '2011-05-29') as db
), a as (
  select r.club, r.elo, (select avg(t.elo) from gold.ratings_on(d.da, true) t where t.tier = 1) as field
  from d, gold.ratings_on(d.da, false) r
  where r.club = coalesce(cast({{wi_a}} as text), 'Manchester United')
), b as (
  select r.club, r.elo, (select avg(t.elo) from gold.ratings_on(d.db, true) t where t.tier = 1) as field
  from d, gold.ratings_on(d.db, false) r
  where r.club = coalesce(cast({{wi_b}} as text), 'Barcelona')
), g as (
  select a.club as club_a, a.elo as elo_a, a.elo - a.field as above_a,
         b.club as club_b, b.elo as elo_b, b.elo - b.field as above_b,
         (a.elo - a.field) - (b.elo - b.field) as gap
  from a cross join b
)
select club_a, round(elo_a)::int as elo_a, round(above_a)::int as above_a,
       club_b, round(elo_b)::int as elo_b, round(above_b)::int as above_b,
       round((elo_a - elo_b)::numeric)::int as raw_gap, round(gap::numeric)::int as era_gap,
       round((1 / (1 + power(10, -gap / 400)))::numeric, 3)::float as a_expected_neutral,
       round((1 / (1 + power(10, -(gap + 70) / 400)))::numeric, 3)::float as a_expected_home,
       round((1 / (1 + power(10, -(gap - 70) / 400)))::numeric, 3)::float as a_expected_away
from g
